stem: Amritdhara waterfall is on which river?
expl: Amritdhara waterfall is on the Hasdeo (Hasdo) River in Chhattisgarh. It is in the Manendragarh- Chirmiri-Bharatpur district of Chhattisgarh, where Amritdhara Festival is organized every year on the occasion of Mahashivratri.

stem: Which waterfall of India is popularly known as Niagara Falls?
expl: Chitrakote waterfalls are popularly known as Niagara Falls of India. They are located near Jagdalpur, in Bastar district of Chhattisgarh on Indravati river.

stem: Which of the following rivers the "Chitrakote" water fall is located?
expl: Chitrakote waterfalls are popularly known as Niagara Falls of India. They are located near Jagdalpur, in Bastar district of Chhattisgarh on Indravati river.

stem: Chitrakote waterfall is situated :
expl: Chitrakote waterfall is a natural waterfall located on the river Indravati. It is situated to the west of Jagdalpur in Bastar district of Chhattisgarh. It is often called the Niagara falls of India.

stem: Which of the following waterfalls of India is located in Goa ?
expl: Dudhsagar falls is located in the Western Ghats. It is situated on river Mandvi (Goa). Dhuandhar falls is situated on Narmada River in Madhya Pradesh whereas Nohkalikai and Landshing are situated in Meghalaya.

stem: Which waterfall is situated on Bhedaghat?
expl: Dhuandhar Fall is a waterfall in Jabalpur district. It is located on Narmada river in Bhedaghat at a height of 30m. Here, Narmada river passes through marble rocks.

stem: Which one of the following is the correct height of Kunchikal Waterfall ?
expl: According to World Waterfalls Database the height of Kunchikal Waterfall is 183m. Earlier, as per the database, it was the tallest plunge waterfall with a height of 455m.

stem: Vembanad lake is in:
expl: Vembanad lake is the largest lake in Kerala. Its length is 83.72 km and its width is 14.48 km . The lake is bordered by Alappuzha, Kottayam and Ernakulam districts of Kerala.

stem: Which one of the following is not a lagoon?
expl: A lagoon is a stretch of salt water separated from the sea by a low sandbank or coral reef. Periyar Lake – It is covers an area of 55 km2. It is an artificial lake. It is not a lagoon as it draws water from the river. Ashtamudi Lake – It is a backwater lagoon in Kerala. Chilika Lake – It is a lagoon located in Odisha. Its maximum length is 64.5 km and its width ranges from 5 km to 18 km. Pulicat Lake – It is a saltwater lagoon on the border of Tamil Nadu and Andhra Pradesh on the Coromandel coast.

stem: Largest saline water lake in India is :
expl: The largest saltwater lagoon lake in India is Chilika lake (Odisha) with an area 900 to 1165 sq. km, while Sambhar Lake (Rajasthan) is the largest inland saltwater lake in the country. Both of the above lakes are included in the Ramsar list.

stem: At which of the following places is the Chilika Lake located?
expl: Chilika Lake is a lagoon an the mouth of River Mahanadi in Odisha. Odisha coast is also called Northern Circar. Karnataka coast is in Karnataka's coastal area. Konkan coast is on Maharashtra's western coast and Malabar coast is on Kerala's western coast.

stem: Which of the following is the largest lagoon lake situated on the east coast of India?
expl: • Pulicat lake is the second largest brackish water lake in the country after Chilika lake. of the state of Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu. • Chilika lake is the largest lake in India on the east coast. It is located in the state of Odisha. • Kulleru (Kolleru) lake is a fresh waterlake, situated situated between the Godavari and Krishna rivers. It is also a Ramsar site located in the state of Andhra Pradesh. • Kilivali Lake located in Tamil Nadu is the second largest saltwater lake in South India after Pulicat lake. stem:
Which of the following statements are correct regarding Yaya Tso Lake?
I. It is located in Ladakh.
II. It is Ladakh's first heritage site under the Biological Diversity Act.
III. It is also known as bird's paradise.
IV. It is fed by Sutlej River.
Select the correct answer from the options given below:
expl: Yaya Tso lake is located in Ladakh. It is also known as bird's paradise for its beautiful lake and is located at an altitude of approx. 4820 meters. Significantly, in January, 2023, the community members Biodiversity Management Committee, the panchayat of Chumathang village, along with GOI- UNDP- GEF Secure Himalaya Project resolved to declare Yaya Tso as Ladakh's first Biodiversity Heritage Site (BHS) under the Biological Diversity Act. Notably, this lake is known as a bird's paradise for its beautiful lake.
